launch_command:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.mercury" && cat > "$HOME/.mercury/mercury.yaml" <<EOF
identity:
  name: Mercury
  owner: ClawGap
  creator: ClawGap
providers:
  default: openaiCompat
  openaiCompat:
    name: openaiCompat
    apiKey: clawgap-loopback-mock
    baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT}/v1
    model: clawgap-environment-probe
    enabled: true
channels:
  telegram:
    enabled: false
memory:
  secondBrain:
    enabled: false
subagents:
  enabled: false
spotify:
  enabled: false
web:
  enabled: false
EOF
cat > "$HOME/.mercury/permissions.yaml" <<'EOF'
capabilities:
  filesystem:
    enabled: true
    scopes:
      - {path: ., read: true, write: true}
  shell:
    enabled: true
    cwdOnly: true
  git:
    enabled: false
EOF
(sleep 8; printf '\033[B'; sleep 1; printf '\r'; sleep 2; printf 'environment probe'; sleep 1; printf '\r') | script -qec 'node dist/index.js start --foreground' /dev/null
